name: bld6_factorial_lt_exp_mul_pow
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : (n.factorial : ℝ) < Real.exp 1 * n * ((n : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ n
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n), (n.factorial : ℝ) < Real.exp 1 * n * ((n : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ n
informal: Uses Mathlib2.calc_exp_lt_one_add_inv_pow_succ: put a_n = n!·e^n/(n·n^n); a_1 = e and a_(n+1)/a_n = e/(1+1/n)^(n+1) < 1 by calc_exp_lt_one_add_inv_pow_succ (the induction step), so a_n < e for n ≥ 2. This is the upper companion of Mathlib2.calc_factorial_gt_div_exp_pow.
